title: Components & Props
description:
## Components & Props Components are the building blocks of React. A component is just a function that returns JSX. **Props** let you pass data from a parent component to a child. ### Key Concepts - Components must start with an **uppercase letter** - Props are passed like HTML attributes: `` - Inside the component, access them via the function parameter: `function Greeting({ name })` - Props are **read-only** — never modify them ### Your Task 1. Create a `UserCard` component that accepts `name` and `role` props - Render an `

` with the role - Wrap both in a `

` with `className="user-card"` 2. In the `App` component, render **two** `UserCard` components: - One with name **"Alice"** and role **"Developer"** - One with name **"Bob"** and role **"Designer"**
